bull_case: AI/HPC, N2/A16 and advanced packaging can drive owner FCF/share toward the Bull path despite higher capex.
bear_case: If overseas-cost dilution and capex absorb AI-era revenue growth, value can fall materially below current price.
thesis: TSM is no longer cheap on the locked owner-FCF DCF, but it does not require a Bull+ outcome. Current price is ~1.15x Base and ~0.72x Bull. The investment case therefore needs better-than-Base FCF compounding, not implausible execution.

evidence.claim: FY2025 OCF was US$72.52B and capex about US$40.56B.
2Q26 revenue was US$40.20B with 67.7% gross margin and 60.3% operating margin.

counterevidence: Overseas fabs carry structurally higher costs; customer concentration and Taiwan/export-control tail risks remain material.
unknowns: AI/HPC demand duration beyond the current capacity-constrained cycle
falsifiers: A sustained loss of leading-edge share, repeated yield delays, or owner FCF/share stagnation despite rising capex would weaken the thesis.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price is above Base but remains well below Bull; the exact predicate of requiring an unrealistic Bull+ case is not established.

key_kpis.name: owner FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: sustained growth through the capex cycle

next_checks: 3Q26 results, N2 ramp, CoWoS/advanced packaging capacity, overseas-fab margin, top-customer concentration
